label: SYNTHETIC PERSONA - fictional, not a real person

linkedin.headline: Live sound engineer | Static Orchard Audio
linkedin.about: I mix live bands in small venues and I record in a home studio. I am a night owl with a dry, absurdist sense of humour and I stay loyal to the friends and bands I believe in. I play guitar badly and listen to vinyl obsessively. Looking for someone who shows up for friends and loves a gig as much as I do.

experience.title: Live Sound Engineer
experience.description: Front-of-house mixing for 150 shows a year.

posts.caption: Another gig survived, ears ringing. The drummer brought a goblin costume for reasons unknown.
Vinyl day haul. My shelf is a structural risk.
Midnight jam in the practice room. Absurd, loud, perfect.
Festival season starts. Pray for my hearing.
